entries.message: Crest for Windows installs for one person without administrator rights, with a Start menu entry, an uninstaller that keeps browsing data unless asked, and Crest registered as a browser Windows can make the default
Settings and Setup on Windows show whether Crest is the default browser, and open Windows' Default apps on Crest's page to make it so
Links and documents other apps open with Crest for Windows land in the running Crest window, in the Space and window the Mac would choose
Crest for Windows checks for updates on its channel, installs only an update signed with Crest's release key, and offers its Software updates settings under About
Releases can publish Crest for Windows' installer and update feed beside the Mac's, and the Windows engine is published from a Windows build machine
Crest for Windows reads extensions other software registers from Crest's own registry key, never Google Chrome's
